summary: Stores a caller-supplied float value (bitcast from integer a2) at this+0x14 and clamps it into the interval bounded by this+0x1C (lower bound) and this+0x20 (upper bound): when the stored value exceeds the upper bound it is overwritten with the upper bound, and when it falls below the lower bound it is overwritten with the lower bound.

operations.description: Read the lower bound from this+0x1C and the upper bound from this+0x20 as floats into locals v2 and v3.
Write the integer argument a2 (bitcast to float) into the destination field at this+0x14.
When the stored value at this+0x14 is greater than the upper bound (v3), clamp it to the upper bound.
When the stored value at this+0x14 is below the lower bound (v2), clamp it to the lower bound.
